name: HomeTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the home team in a match.

name: AwayTeamGoals
definition: Number of goals scored by the away team in a match.

name: Season
definition: Season label of the match.

name: MatchDate
definition: Date on which the match was played.

name: Country
definition: Country in which the league/match is played.

name: TeamName
definition: Name of the football team.

name: BuildUpPlaySpeed
definition: Team's build-up play speed rating.
aliases: speed in which attacks are put together

name: ChanceCreationPassing
definition: Team's chance creation passing score.

name: ChanceCreationPassingClass
definition: Classification label of the chance creation passing score.

name: Height
definition: Player's height in centimeters.

name: Weight
definition: Player's weight.

name: BirthDate
definition: Player's date of birth.

name: PlayerName
definition: Full name of the football player.

name: PlayerID
definition: Unique identifier of the football player.

name: AverageHomeGoals
definition: Average number of home goals per match. Formula: SUM(HomeTeamGoals) / COUNT(DISTINCT tab07.fld001). Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = tab07.fld080

name: DrawMatches
definition: Count of matches where home and away goals are equal. Formula: SUM(CASE WHEN HomeTeamGoals = AwayTeamGoals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Inputs: HomeTeamGoals = tab07.fld080; AwayTeamGoals = tab07.fld081

name: PlayerAge
definition: Player's current age computed from birth date. Formula: DATETIME() - BirthDate. Inputs: BirthDate = tab02.fld044
